Balcony fall under investigation in PCB

Death investigation underway
By WJHG Newsroom
Published: Nov. 25, 2026 at 9:00 PM EST|Updated: 8 hours ago
Add Us On GoogleAdd as a preferred source on Google
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:52
Instaread

PANAMA CITY BEACH, Fla. (WJHG/WECP) - Panama City Beach officials say they are conducting a death investigation after reports of a balcony fall.

Officials say the incident happened at the Aqua Resort on Front Beach Rd, when they received the call around 7:15 pm.

An official with Panama City Beach confirms the victim was not a child.

The investigation is ongoing, and no other details are being released at this time.
